# Same Day Recycling

> Canada's intelligent recycling and removal network. Junk, furniture and appliance removal requests are accepted nationwide through an operator network across Canada, along with a free national recycling directory and a software operating system licensed to independent recycling businesses across Canada. Same-day fulfillment depends on confirmed contractor availability in each city. Book online at https://samedayrecycling.ca/#book or call (604) 849-1745 — open 24 hours.

## What Same Day Recycling does

- **Pickup requests (consumer & business):** junk removal, furniture removal, appliance removal, estate/garage/condo cleanouts. Same-day service is the operating goal and is subject to contractor availability; requests outside same-day windows are scheduled for the next available slot. Upfront pricing from $139 (small load) to $649 (full truck), free estimates, price approved before loading. Curbside Discount: $25 off when items are staged outside and no one is home.
- **Free scrap metal pickup:** metal is collected at no charge wherever a network partner is live (https://samedayrecycling.ca/free-metal-pickup).
- **Recycling directory:** searchable, verified listings of where to recycle materials across Canada, by material and city (https://samedayrecycling.ca/recycling).
- **Recycling assistant:** AI chat that answers how-to-recycle questions with cited sources and local provider suggestions (https://samedayrecycling.ca/recycling-assistant).
- **Software OS for recycling businesses:** licensed white-label dashboard giving independent companies customer management, dispatch, scheduling, invoicing and analytics (https://samedayrecycling.ca/software). Plans: Starter $2,500 setup + $199/mo; Growth $4,500 + $399/mo; Network $9,500 + $799/mo; annual billing = 10 months' price.

## Coverage (current)

- **Nationwide service requests:** accepted in every Canadian province and territory; local pickup availability is confirmed per job after contractor matching.
- **Active dispatch territories:** 29 cities including Vancouver, Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal, Halifax, Whitehorse, Yellowknife and Iqaluit; same-day fulfillment depends on confirmed contractor availability in each city.
- **Partner onboarding:** contractor territory applications at https://samedayrecycling.ca/contractor-onboarding.
- **Province and territory pages:** https://samedayrecycling.ca/coverage

## Pricing

- Truck-space pricing: $139–$649 CAD depending on load size and city; free quote at https://samedayrecycling.ca/#book or photo quote by text to (604) 849-1745.

## Sustainability claims (cited)

- Canada diverted 27.1% of solid waste in 2022; landfills accounted for 17% of national methane emissions (Environment and Climate Change Canada).
- Recycling aluminum uses about 95% less energy than producing it from raw ore (International Aluminium Institute).
